newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse eases in lacklustre trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse eases in lacklustre trading.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index, on a downward drift since Friday last week, shed a further 4.25 points to close at 3444.44 in lacklustre trading, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 13.219 million shillings on 303,130 shares from 31.821 million shillings traded on 570,781 shares on Wednesday.
Bourse officials said the market's pace appeared to have slowed down, with a noticeable absence of trading of large lots.

Brokers said the gradual sliding of the index towards the 3400 level was a result of investors adopting a wait-and-see attitude now that the traditional excitement about anticipated year-end results at the beginning of the year, had waned.
"Investors are now going to make rational decisions and not ride on emotions generated by excitement," a senior broker said.
Barclays Bank gained a shilling to close at 115 while Standard Chartered Bank was unchanged at 55. British American Tobacco (BAT) Kenya shed three shillings to close at 80.
Lonrho Motors closed at 120 from 125. Sasini Tea & Coffee closed at 60 from 59.50.
Kenya Commercial Bank was unchanged at 90 while Kenya Power & Lighting edged up to 98.50 from 95.
Some five million shillings of the East African Development Bank EADB.NR corporate bond traded at 99.70 percent.
